headline: Government and Budget: The Battle for the Rest of the Year
summary: Jordan's government aims to maintain economic and financial stability in the second half of the year. Indicators show the economy is still moving along a cohesive path, according to the article.
why: Jordan's budget and reform progress influence its credit standing and the financing terms it receives from international lenders.
